words.gloss: under the sway of the six enemies

hindi: यदि वह सन्धि पर स्थिर न रहे, तो उससे कहे — "शत्रुरूप षड्वर्ग के वश में पड़े ये राजा नष्ट हो गए; उन अनात्मवानों के मार्ग पर चलना तुम्हें उचित नहीं।
english: If he does not abide by the peace, (the envoy) should tell him: "These kings, under the sway of the group of six enemies, have perished; you ought not to follow the path of those who were not self-possessed.
notes: The quotation opened here runs on through unit 7 (closed by 'iti yacchet'). śatru-ṣaḍ-varga = the six (inner) enemies, the ṣaḍvarga; the subject of brūyāt (the envoy) is carried over from the previous section.
lines_deva: स चेत् सन्धौ न-अवतिष्ठेत, ब्रूयाद् एनं - "इमे शत्रु.षड्.वर्ग.वशगा राजानो विनष्टाः, तेषाम् अनात्मवतां न-अर्हसि मार्गम् अनुगन्तुम्
lines_iast: sa cet sandhau na-avatiṣṭheta, brūyād enaṃ - "ime śatru.ṣaḍ.varga.vaśagā rājāno vinaṣṭāḥ, teṣām anātmavatāṃ na-arhasi mārgam anugantum

hindi: धर्म और अर्थ का ध्यान रखो।
english: Have regard for dharma and wealth.
lines_deva: धर्मम् अर्थं च-अवेक्षस्व
lines_iast: dharmam arthaṃ ca-avekṣasva

hindi: क्योंकि जो तुमसे साहस, अधर्म और अर्थ का अतिक्रमण करवाते हैं, वे मित्र का मुख धारण किए हुए शत्रु हैं।
english: For those who make you undertake rashness, unrighteousness and transgression of wealth are enemies wearing the faces of friends.
notes: artha-atikrama: literally 'going beyond (i.e. forfeiting) wealth'; defined in unit 4.
lines_deva: मित्र.मुखा ह्य् अमित्रास् ते ये त्वा साहसम् अधर्मम् अर्थ.अतिक्रमं च ग्राहयन्ति
lines_iast: mitra.mukhā hy amitrās te ye tvā sāhasam adharmam artha.atikramaṃ ca grāhayanti

words.gloss: who have given up their lives

hindi: प्राण त्यागने को तैयार शूरों के साथ युद्ध करना साहस है; दोनों ओर जन-क्षय करना अधर्म है; प्रत्यक्ष लाभ और निर्दोष मित्र को त्याग देना अर्थ का अतिक्रमण है।
english: To fight with brave men who have given up their lives is rashness; to cause loss of men on both sides is unrighteousness; to abandon an assured gain and an uncorrupted ally is transgression of wealth.
lines_deva: शूरैस् त्यक्त.आत्मभिः सह योद्धुं साहसम्, जन.क्षयम् उभयतः कर्तुम् अधर्मः, दृष्टम् अर्थं मित्रम् अदुष्टं च त्यक्तुम् अर्थ.अतिक्रमः
lines_iast: śūrais tyakta.ātmabhiḥ saha yoddhuṃ sāhasam, jana.kṣayam ubhayataḥ kartum adharmaḥ, dṛṣṭam arthaṃ mitram aduṣṭaṃ ca tyaktum artha.atikramaḥ

hindi: और वह राजा मित्रों वाला है; इसके अतिरिक्त इस धन से वह ऐसे मित्रों को उद्यत करेगा जो तुम पर सब ओर से चढ़ाई करेंगे।
english: And that king has allies; further, with this wealth he will set in motion allies who will march against you from all sides.
notes: 'that king' = the weaker king on whose behalf the envoy speaks.
lines_deva: मित्रवांश् च स राजा, भूयश् च-एतेन-अर्थेन मित्राण्य् उद्योजयिष्यति यानि त्वा सर्वतो ऽभियास्यन्ति
lines_iast: mitravāṃś ca sa rājā, bhūyaś ca-etena-arthena mitrāṇy udyojayiṣyati yāni tvā sarvato 'bhiyāsyanti

words.gloss: by the middle and the neutral king

hindi: और वह मध्यम और उदासीन राजाओं द्वारा या मण्डल द्वारा त्यागा हुआ नहीं है; किन्तु आप त्यागे हुए हैं, क्योंकि वे युद्ध के लिए पूरी तरह उद्यत आपको यह सोचते हुए देखते रहते हैं — "यह और भी क्षय और व्यय से जुड़े, मित्र से अलग हो जाए; फिर जिसका मूल छूट गया है, ऐसे इसे हम सुखपूर्वक उखाड़ देंगे।"
english: And he is not abandoned by the middle and the neutral king, or by the circle; but you are abandoned, since they look on at you, fully prepared (for war), (thinking) "Let him be further subjected to loss and expense, and let him be cut off from his ally; then, his base abandoned, we shall easily exterminate him."
notes: yattvā is printed as one token; split yat tvā. madhyama-udāsīnayoḥ and maṇḍalasya are genitives of agent with parityaktaḥ. parityakta-mūla: alternatively 'whose root (home base) is lost'.
lines_deva: न च मध्यम.उदासीनयोर् मण्डलस्य वा परित्यक्तः, भवांस् तु परित्यक्तः यत्त्वा समुद्युक्तम् उपप्रेक्षन्ते "भूयः क्षय.व्ययाभ्यां युज्यताम्, मित्राच् च भिद्यताम्, अथ-एनं परित्यक्त.मूलं सुखेन-उच्छेत्स्यामः" इति
lines_iast: na ca madhyama.udāsīnayor maṇḍalasya vā parityaktaḥ, bhavāṃs tu parityaktaḥ yattvā samudyuktam upaprekṣante "bhūyaḥ kṣaya.vyayābhyāṃ yujyatām, mitrāc ca bhidyatām, atha-enaṃ parityakta.mūlaṃ sukhena-ucchetsyāmaḥ" iti

hindi: अतः आपको उचित नहीं कि मित्र का मुख धारण किए शत्रुओं की बात सुनें, मित्रों को उद्विग्न करें और शत्रुओं को श्रेय से जोड़ें, तथा प्राण-संशय और अनर्थ को प्राप्त हों" — इस प्रकार वह उसे रोके।
english: So you ought not to listen to enemies wearing the faces of friends, to alarm your allies and to join your enemies with good fortune, or to incur peril to life and calamity" — thus he should restrain him.
notes: yacchet: 3 sg. opt. of √yam 'hold back, restrain'; alternatively 'should offer (these words)', but 'restrain' fits the sense of dissuading. 'amitrān śreyasā yoktum' = to let the enemies gain the advantage.
lines_deva: स भवान् न-अर्हति मित्र.मुखानाम् अमित्राणां श्रोतुम्, मित्राण्य् उद्वेजयितुम् अमित्रांश् च श्रेयसा योक्तुम्, प्राण.संशयम् अनर्थं च-उपगन्तुम्" इति यच्छेत्
lines_iast: sa bhavān na-arhati mitra.mukhānām amitrāṇāṃ śrotum, mitrāṇy udvejayitum amitrāṃś ca śreyasā yoktum, prāṇa.saṃśayam anarthaṃ ca-upagantum" iti yacchet

words.gram: m. gen. sg., pres. part. pra-√sthā

words.gloss: in (the section on) the Conduct of Corporations

hindi: फिर भी यदि वह चढ़ाई के लिए निकल ही पड़े, तो उसकी प्रकृतियों का कोप करवाए, जैसा सङ्घवृत्त और योगवामन में समझाया गया है।
english: Even so, if he sets out (on the march), he should cause disaffection of his constituent elements, as has been explained in the Conduct of Corporations and in the Yogavamana.
notes: saṅgha-vṛtta and yoga-vāmana are names of other sections of the book; kept as names. pratiṣṭhamānasya ... asya: both genitives refer to the stronger king.
lines_deva: तथा-अपि प्रतिष्ठमानस्य प्रकृति.कोपम् अस्य कारयेद् यथा सङ्घ.वृत्ते व्याख्यातं योग.वामने च
lines_iast: tathā-api pratiṣṭhamānasya prakṛti.kopam asya kārayed yathā saṅgha.vṛtte vyākhyātaṃ yoga.vāmane ca

hindi: और तीक्ष्णों तथा रसदों का प्रयोग भी करवाए।
english: And (he should cause) the employment of assassins and poisoners.
notes: tīkṣṇa = the 'fierce' agent (assassin), rasada = 'poison-giver'; the verb kārayet is carried over from unit 8.
lines_deva: तीक्ष्ण.रसद.प्रयोगं च
lines_iast: tīkṣṇa.rasada.prayogaṃ ca

words.gloss: in (the section on) the Protection of One's Person

hindi: आत्मरक्षितक में जिससे बचकर रहने को कहा गया है, वहाँ (उन्हीं उपायों में) तीक्ष्णों और रसदों को लगाए।
english: What has been stated in the Protection of One's Person as things to be guarded against, there he should employ assassins and poisoners.
notes: ātma-rakṣitaka is a section name (on the king's personal safety); the dangers it tells the king to guard against are the ones to be used here.
lines_deva: यद् उक्तम् आत्म.रक्षितके रक्ष्यं तत्र तीक्ष्णान् रसदांश् च प्रयुञ्जीत
lines_iast: yad uktam ātma.rakṣitake rakṣyaṃ tatra tīkṣṇān rasadāṃś ca prayuñjīta

hindi: वेश्याओं के पालक अत्यन्त रूप और यौवन वाली स्त्रियों से सेना के मुख्य पुरुषों को उन्मत्त कर दें।
english: Keepers of courtesans should drive the chiefs of the army mad with women of supreme beauty and youth.
lines_deva: बन्धकी.पोषकाः परम.रूप.यौवनाभिः स्त्रीभिः सेना.मुख्यान् उन्मादयेयुः
lines_iast: bandhakī.poṣakāḥ parama.rūpa.yauvanābhiḥ strībhiḥ senā.mukhyān unmādayeyuḥ

hindi: जब बहुतों को या दो मुख्य पुरुषों को एक ही स्त्री के प्रति कामना उत्पन्न हो जाए, तब तीक्ष्ण (उनके बीच) कलह उत्पन्न करें।
english: When desire for one (woman) has arisen in many, or in two chiefs, the assassins should stir up quarrels.
notes: kāme jāte: locative absolute.
lines_deva: बहूनाम् एकस्यां द्वयोर् वा मुख्ययोः कामे जाते तीक्ष्णाः कलहान् उत्पादयेयुः
lines_iast: bahūnām ekasyāṃ dvayor vā mukhyayoḥ kāme jāte tīkṣṇāḥ kalahān utpādayeyuḥ

words.gloss: in giving help to the expedition

hindi: कलह में पराजित पक्ष को वे अन्यत्र चले जाने में, अथवा (अपने) स्वामी की यात्रा में सहायता देने में लगा दें।
english: In the quarrel, they should engage the defeated side in going away elsewhere, or in giving help to the expedition of (their) master.
notes: bhartuḥ 'the master' = the king employing the agents (the weaker king); construed with yātrā-sāhāyya-dāne.
lines_deva: कलहे पराजित.पक्षं परत्र.अपगमने यात्रा.साहाय्य.दाने वा भर्तुर् योजयेयुः
lines_iast: kalahe parājita.pakṣaṃ paratra.apagamane yātrā.sāhāyya.dāne vā bhartur yojayeyuḥ

words.gloss: those under the sway of love
agents in the guise of holy men

hindi: अथवा सिद्ध के वेश वाले गुप्तचर, काम के वश में पड़े हुओं से, वशीकरण की औषधियों के द्वारा, धोखा देने के लिए मुख्य पुरुषों को विष दिलवा दें।
english: Or agents in the guise of holy men should, by means of love-winning herbs, for the purpose of overreaching (the victims), cause those under the sway of love to administer poison among the chiefs.
notes: sāṃvadanikī: 'serving to win over (a lover)', a love-charm. rasa here = poison (as in rasada). atisandhāna = deceiving/overreaching.
lines_deva: काम.वशान् वा सिद्ध.व्यञ्जनाः सांवदनिकीभिर् ओषधीभिर् अतिसन्धानाय मुख्येषु रसं दापयेयुः
lines_iast: kāma.vaśān vā siddha.vyañjanāḥ sāṃvadanikībhir oṣadhībhir atisandhānāya mukhyeṣu rasaṃ dāpayeyuḥ

words.gloss: an agent in the guise of a trader

hindi: अथवा व्यापारी के वेश वाला गुप्तचर, राजा की प्रिय महिषी की निकटवर्ती दासी पर काम के बहाने धन बरसाकर, उसे छोड़ दे।
english: Or an agent in the guise of a trader, having showered with money, on the pretext of love, a maidservant close to the king's favourite chief queen, should abandon her.

text_flags.why: possible: the agent is the subject of parityajet and the parallel units (16, 19, 21, 22, 23) all have the nominative -vyañjanaḥ; a locative here has no clear construction

notes: src has the locative vyañjane; words give the nominative, see text_flags. If the locative is kept, it could only be read loosely as 'in the role of a trader' with the subject unexpressed.
lines_deva: वैदेहक.व्यञ्जने वा राज.महिष्याः सुभगायाः प्रेष्याम् आसन्नां काम.निमित्तम् अर्थेन-अभिवृष्य परित्यजेत्
lines_iast: vaidehaka.vyañjane vā rāja.mahiṣyāḥ subhagāyāḥ preṣyām āsannāṃ kāma.nimittam arthena-abhivṛṣya parityajet

words.gloss: pointed out by an agent in the guise of (his) servant
an agent in the guise of a holy man

hindi: उसी (व्यापारी) के सेवक के वेश वाले गुप्तचर द्वारा बताया गया सिद्ध-वेशधारी गुप्तचर (उस दासी को) वशीकरण की औषधि दे — "इसे वैदेहक के शरीर पर लगाना है" ऐसा कहकर।
english: An agent in the guise of a holy man, pointed out (to her) by an agent in the guise of that very (trader's) servant, should give (her) a love-winning herb, (saying) "it is to be applied on the trader's body."

text_flags.why: possible: the parallel instruction in unit 17 reads 'vadhātavyā (ava-√dhā, 'to be put on'); avaghātavyā (ava-√han, 'to be struck/pounded') is also construable, so the e-text reading is kept in words

notes: Reading kept as printed: avaghātavyā 'to be struck (applied with a blow)' on the body; unit 17 has avadhātavyā 'to be placed'. One of the two may be a typo; which one is uncertain.
lines_deva: तस्य-एव परिचारक.व्यञ्जन.उपदिष्टः सिद्ध.व्यञ्जनः सांवदनिकीम् ओषधीं दद्यात् "वैदेहक.शरीरे ऽवघातव्या" इति
lines_iast: tasya-eva paricāraka.vyañjana.upadiṣṭaḥ siddha.vyañjanaḥ sāṃvadanikīm oṣadhīṃ dadyāt "vaidehaka.śarīre 'vaghātavyā" iti

hindi: इसके सफल हो जाने पर वह प्रिय महिषी को भी यही योग बताए — "इसे राजा के शरीर पर लगाना है।"
english: When this has succeeded, he should teach the favourite (queen) too this same device: "it is to be applied on the king's body."
notes: siddhe: locative absolute (the trick having worked on the maidservant). subhagāyāḥ: genitive used for the recipient of the instruction.
lines_deva: सिद्धे सुभगाया अप्य् एनं योगम् उपदिशेत् "राज.शरीरे ऽवधातव्या" इति
lines_iast: siddhe subhagāyā apy enaṃ yogam upadiśet "rāja.śarīre 'vadhātavyā" iti

hindi: फिर विष के द्वारा (राजा को) धोखा दे दे।
english: Then he should overreach (the king) with poison.
notes: i.e. the 'herb' handed over is replaced by poison.
lines_deva: ततो रसेन-अतिसन्दध्यात्
lines_iast: tato rasena-atisandadhyāt

words.gloss: an agent in the guise of a fortune-teller
endowed with the marks of a king

hindi: अथवा ज्योतिषी के वेश वाला गुप्तचर, क्रमशः अपने वश में लाए गए किसी महामात्र से कहे कि "तुम राजा के लक्षणों से सम्पन्न हो।"
english: Or an agent in the guise of a fortune-teller should tell a high official who has been won over step by step that he is "endowed with the marks of a king."
notes: kārtāntika = reader of fate (astrologer). krama-abhinīta: brought (round) by degrees.
lines_deva: कार्तान्तिक.व्यञ्जनो वा महा.मात्रं "राज.लक्षण.सम्पन्नम्" क्रम.अभिनीतं ब्रूयात्
lines_iast: kārtāntika.vyañjano vā mahā.mātraṃ "rāja.lakṣaṇa.sampannam" krama.abhinītaṃ brūyāt

hindi: एक भिक्षुकी उसकी पत्नी से (कहे) — "तुम राजा की पत्नी या राजा की माता बनोगी।"
english: A female mendicant (should tell) his wife: "You will become a king's wife or the mother of a king."
notes: The verb brūyāt is carried over from unit 19.
lines_deva: भार्याम् अस्य भिक्षुकी "राज.पत्नी राज.प्रसविनी वा भविष्यसि" इति
lines_iast: bhāryām asya bhikṣukī "rāja.patnī rāja.prasavinī vā bhaviṣyasi" iti

words.gloss: a woman agent in the guise of his wife

hindi: अथवा (उसकी) पत्नी के वेश वाली गुप्तचर स्त्री महामात्र से कहे — "सुना है, राजा मुझे (अपने अन्तःपुर में) रोक रखेगा; यह पत्र-लेख और यह आभूषण परिव्राजिका ने तुम्हारे पास (पहुँचाने के) लिए लाया है।"
english: Or a woman agent in the guise of (his) wife should tell the high official: "The king, it is said, will confine me (in his harem); this letter and this ornament have been brought by a wandering nun for your presence."
notes: bhāryā-vyañjanā: literally 'with the appearance of a wife'; may mean the official's own wife acting as an agent. tava antikāya = 'to (be delivered into) your presence'. avarodhayiṣyati: 'will shut (me) in the harem'.
lines_deva: भार्या.व्यञ्जना वा महा.मात्रं ब्रूयात् "राजा किल माम् अवरोधयिष्यति, तव-अन्तिकाय पत्त्र.लेख्यम् आभरणं च-इदं परिव्राजिकया-आहृतम्" इति
lines_iast: bhāryā.vyañjanā vā mahā.mātraṃ brūyāt "rājā kila mām avarodhayiṣyati, tava-antikāya pattra.lekhyam ābharaṇaṃ ca-idaṃ parivrājikayā-āhṛtam" iti

words.gloss: an agent in the guise of a cook or kitchen-hand
for the purpose of administering poison

hindi: अथवा रसोइये या रसोई-सेवक के वेश वाला गुप्तचर उसके सामने विष-प्रयोग के लिए राजा का सन्देश और लुभाने वाला धन प्रस्तुत करे।
english: Or an agent in the guise of a cook or kitchen-hand should present to him a message of the king, together with tempting money, for the administering of poison.
notes: rāja-vacana: the text does not say which king's message is meant nor who is to be poisoned; the agent brings the official a king's message proposing the use of poison, backed by a bribe. abhinayet (abhi-√nī): 'act out, bring before'.
lines_deva: सूद.आरालिक.व्यञ्जनो वा रस.प्रयोग.अर्थं राज.वचनम् अर्थं च-अस्य लोभनीयम् अभिनयेत्
lines_iast: sūda.ārālika.vyañjano vā rasa.prayoga.arthaṃ rāja.vacanam arthaṃ ca-asya lobhanīyam abhinayet

words.gloss: an agent in the guise of a trader

hindi: व्यापारी के वेश वाला गुप्तचर उसके सामने उसकी पुष्टि करे और कार्य की सिद्धि (हो गई) ऐसा कहे।
english: An agent in the guise of a trader should corroborate that to him, and should declare the accomplishment of the task.
notes: pratisandadhyāt: 'should fit together, confirm'; alternatively 'should follow it up'.
lines_deva: तद् अस्य वैदेहक.व्यञ्जनः प्रतिसन्दध्यात्, कार्य.सिद्धिं च ब्रूयात्
lines_iast: tad asya vaidehaka.vyañjanaḥ pratisandadhyāt, kārya.siddhiṃ ca brūyāt

hindi: इस प्रकार एक, दो या तीन ऐसे उपायों से उसके एक-एक महामात्र को आक्रमण करने या चले जाने में लगा दे। इति।
english: Thus, by one, two or three such means, he should bring each high official of his to an attack or to going away. Thus (ends the section).
notes: The danda and 'iti' in the e-text close the section on winning over the high officials; 'iti' is translated as a section-closer.
lines_deva: एवम् एकेन द्वाभ्यां त्रिभिर् इत्य् उपायैर् एक.एकम् अस्य महा.मात्रं विक्रमाय-अपगमनाय वा योजयेत् । इति
lines_iast: evam ekena dvābhyāṃ tribhir ity upāyair eka.ekam asya mahā.mātraṃ vikramāya-apagamanāya vā yojayet | iti

words.gloss: among the citizens and country people

hindi: और उसके दुर्गों में शून्यपाल के निकट रहने वाले सत्री पौरों और जानपदों के बीच मित्रता के बहाने यह सूचना फैलाएँ — "शून्यपाल ने योद्धाओं और अधिकारियों से कहा है: 'कठिनाई में पड़ा राजा जीवित लौटेगा या नहीं; बलपूर्वक धन अर्जित कर लो और शत्रुओं को मार डालो।'"
english: And in his forts, secret agents close to the regent should report among the citizens and country people, under the pretext of friendship: "The soldiers and the officials have been told by the regent: 'The king, fallen into difficulty, will return alive, or not; acquire wealth by force, and kill the enemies.'"
notes: śūnya-pāla: 'guardian of the empty (capital)', the officer left in charge while the king is away on campaign; rendered 'regent'. adhikaraṇastha = one holding an office. ārjayadhvam: 2 pl. impv. of √arj (cl. 10, arjayati), 'procure'.
lines_deva: दुर्गेषु च-अस्य शून्य.पाल.आसन्नाः सत्त्रिणः पौर.जानपदेषु मैत्री.निमित्तम् आवेदयेयुः - "शून्य.पालेन-उक्ता योधाश् च-अधिकरणस्थाश् च "कृच्छ्र.गतो राजा जीवन्न् आगमिष्यति, न वा, प्रसह्य वित्तम् आर्जयध्वम्, अमित्रांश् च हत" इति
lines_iast: durgeṣu ca-asya śūnya.pāla.āsannāḥ sattriṇaḥ paura.jānapadeṣu maitrī.nimittam āvedayeyuḥ - "śūnya.pālena-uktā yodhāś ca-adhikaraṇasthāś ca "kṛcchra.gato rājā jīvann āgamiṣyati, na vā, prasahya vittam ārjayadhvam, amitrāṃś ca hata" iti

hindi: जब यह बात फैल जाए, तब तीक्ष्ण रातों में पौरों को लुटवाएँ और मुख्य पुरुषों को मार डालें — "जो शून्यपाल की आज्ञा नहीं मानते, उनके साथ ऐसा ही किया जाता है।"
english: When this has spread widely, the assassins should have the citizens robbed at night, and should strike down the chiefs, (saying) "Thus are those dealt with who do not obey the regent."
notes: āhārayeyuḥ: causative of ā-√hṛ 'take away', i.e. have (the citizens' property) carried off; alternatively 'have the citizens seized'. bahulī-bhūte: locative absolute, 'when (the rumour) has become widespread'.
lines_deva: बहुली.भूते तीक्ष्णाः पौरान् निशास्व् आहारयेयुः, मुख्यांश् च-अभिहन्युः "एवं क्रियन्ते ये शून्य.पालस्य न शुश्रूषन्ते" इति
lines_iast: bahulī.bhūte tīkṣṇāḥ paurān niśāsv āhārayeyuḥ, mukhyāṃś ca-abhihanyuḥ "evaṃ kriyante ye śūnya.pālasya na śuśrūṣante" iti

hindi: और शून्यपाल के स्थानों में वे रक्त से सने शस्त्र, धन और बन्धन छोड़ दें।
english: And in the regent's places they should leave behind blood-stained weapons, money and fetters.
lines_deva: शून्य.पाल.स्थानेषु च सशोणितानि शस्त्र.वित्त.बन्धनान्य् उत्सृजेयुः
lines_iast: śūnya.pāla.sthāneṣu ca saśoṇitāni śastra.vitta.bandhanāny utsṛjeyuḥ

hindi: फिर सत्री यह सूचना फैलाएँ — "शून्यपाल (लोगों को) मरवा रहा है और लुटवा रहा है।"
english: Then the secret agents should report: "The regent is causing killings and plunder."
lines_deva: ततः सत्त्रिणः "शून्य.पालो घातयति विलोपयति च" इत्य् आवेदयेयुः
lines_iast: tataḥ sattriṇaḥ "śūnya.pālo ghātayati vilopayati ca" ity āvedayeyuḥ

hindi: इसी प्रकार वे जानपदों को समाहर्ता से फोड़ दें।
english: In the same way they should alienate the country people from the Collector (samāhartṛ).
notes: samāhartṛ: the Collector-general of revenue. samāhartuḥ taken as ablative (alienate from); a genitive reading 'the Collector's country people' is also possible.
lines_deva: एवं जानपदान् समाहर्तुर् भेदयेयुः
lines_iast: evaṃ jānapadān samāhartur bhedayeyuḥ

hindi: और तीक्ष्ण रात में गाँवों के बीच समाहर्ता के पुरुषों को मारकर कहें — "जो जनपद को अधर्म से पीड़ित करते हैं, उनके साथ ऐसा ही किया जाता है।"
english: But the assassins, having killed the Collector's men in the midst of villages at night, should say: "Thus are those dealt with who oppress the country unjustly."
lines_deva: समाहर्तृ.पुरुषांस् तु ग्राम.मध्येषु रात्रौ तीक्ष्णा हत्वा ब्रूयुः "एवं क्रियन्ते ये जन.पदम् अधर्मेण बाधन्ते" इति
lines_iast: samāhartṛ.puruṣāṃs tu grāma.madhyeṣu rātrau tīkṣṇā hatvā brūyuḥ "evaṃ kriyante ye jana.padam adharmeṇa bādhante" iti

words.gloss: through the anger of the constituent elements

hindi: दोष उत्पन्न हो जाने पर वे प्रकृतियों के कोप के द्वारा शून्यपाल या समाहर्ता को मरवा डालें।
english: When the grievance has arisen, they should have the regent or the Collector killed through the anger of the constituent elements.
notes: doṣa here = the fault (grievance) that the people now attribute to the officer, i.e. the resentment produced; samutpanne doṣe is a locative absolute.
lines_deva: समुत्पन्ने दोषे शून्य.पालं समाहर्तारं वा प्रकृति.कोपेन घातयेयुः
lines_iast: samutpanne doṣe śūnya.pālaṃ samāhartāraṃ vā prakṛti.kopena ghātayeyuḥ

hindi: अथवा वे उसके कुल के किसी व्यक्ति को या किसी अपरुद्ध को (उसके स्थान पर) स्थापित करें।
english: Or they should install (in his place) a member of his family or one who is in disfavour.
notes: aparuddha: 'kept away, confined', a prince or kinsman in disfavour. pratipādayeyuḥ: 'put forward, set up'; alternatively 'hand over (the fort) to'.
lines_deva: तत्.कुलीनम् अपरुद्धं वा प्रतिपादयेयुः
lines_iast: tat.kulīnam aparuddhaṃ vā pratipādayeyuḥ

words.gloss: the harem and the city gate
the stores of goods and grain

hindi: वे अन्तःपुर, नगर-द्वार और द्रव्य तथा धान्य के भण्डारों को जला दें, अथवा उन (अधिकारियों) को मार डालें; और वे आर्त बनकर बोलते हुए उसे (यह सब) बताएँ।
english: They should burn the harem, the city gate and the stores of goods and grain, or should kill those (officers); and, speaking as men in distress, should tell him (of it).
notes: antaḥ-pura-pura-dvāram: dvandva of antaḥpura and pura-dvāra in the singular. tān 'them' most naturally = the regent/Collector of unit 31. ārta-vādinaḥ: agents who speak as if afflicted, reporting these events to the (stronger) king to alarm him. Verse (śloka) unit closing the chapter in the e-text.
lines_deva: अन्तः.पुर.पुर.द्वारं द्रव्य.धान्य.परिग्रहान्
दहेयुस् तांश् च हन्युर् वा ब्रूयुर् अस्य-आर्त.वादिनः
lines_iast: antaḥ.pura.pura.dvāraṃ dravya.dhānya.parigrahān
daheyus tāṃś ca hanyur vā brūyur asya-ārta.vādinaḥ
